name: Google Books
description: Google Books is a comprehensive platform for discovering, reading, and managing a vast collection of books online. It offers users the ability to search for books, read previews, and access a wide range of literary content from various genres and authors.

events.d: Add a specific volume to a selected bookshelf in the user's Google Books library.
List the books on a user's Google Books bookshelf.
Search for books by query with optional filters like country, language, print type, download, and paging.
